instagram.caption:
Baseball parents, not sure what to charge per square? Swipe through the three prices that work.

$5 for family and friends. $10 for a team fundraiser. $20 for the office.

100 squares at $10 is $1,000, with half to the winner and half toward tournament fees, new uniforms or the Cooperstown fund, for example.

Make your free board at the link in bio. Save this for pricing day.

#TravelBaseball #LittleLeague #TeamFundraiser #FootballSquares #ThanksgivingFootball

slides.body: Grandparents, cousins, neighbors. A low price gets a fast yes.
The sweet spot for most teams. Tournament fees, uniforms or the Cooperstown fund.
Coworkers like a bigger pot, and the team gets a bigger half.
